## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is limited to the approved change.
- [ ] No parallel canonical specification, plan, or task list was created.
- [ ] Documentation and agent instructions are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, local runtime state, or generated reports are committed.
- [ ] The change is ready for independent review.
